description: The world model, pilot for ¶1–46: one fact per line. `of` an entity, `attr` the attribute, `value` an entity id or short text, `time` {at} or {from, to} (an open end: until further notice). `para`/`quote` where the story tells it. `basis`: stated (the default), implied (the text presupposes it) or inferable (`from` the facts it follows from; `inferable_at` the paragraph). `truth` from the answer key: true (the default), false, or null (the story never settles it). A `says` fact is true when it was said; what it says is a question's possibility (`q`, `pick`). Provenance is not written on a fact: each told fact is in one or more accounts (accounts.json), and `tells` facts (`value` an account, `to` the receiver, `how`; `partial` when the story says only part of it was passed) carry accounts from holder to holder; scripts/world-provenance.js derives the chains. `old`: the old game's claims or events it comes from. Two dates: `given_at` is where the story states it (default `para`; earlier with `given_quote` when an earlier line already says it, later — even past ¶46 — for a fact only inferable here), `inferable_at` the earliest paragraph it follows from what came before (`from`; `strength: likely` when a careful reader would hold it but it does not follow strictly). `given_at`: where the story gives it away, when later than ¶46.
